reference.question: A spring has an original length of 10 cm and stretches by 0.5 cm for every 1 kg of mass hung from it. What is the spring's length in cm when a 6 kg object is hung from it?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Evaluate the spring-length model

The length is $y=10+0.5x$. When $x=6$, $y=10+3=13$.
